newsitem.title: CHINA: China to use 100 mln tons of rolled steel in 1997.
newsitem.headline: China to use 100 mln tons of rolled steel in 1997.

text.p: China is expected to consume a record of more than 100 million tonnes of rolled steel in 1997, with domestic production expected to rise to 88.5 million tonnes, the official Xinhua news agency said on Friday.
About 10 million tonnes of imports would help meet domestic demand, Xinhua said.
China's iron and steel enterprises were still under great pressure from foreign competition despite the expected record demand, Xinhua said but gave no comparative figures.
Current annual rolled steel production capacity had already surpassed 100 million tonnes, it said but did not elaborate.
